title: Reproducible macroscopic dynamics in a closed-loop human-AI learning system
abstract: arXiv:2608.30946v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Closed-loop human-AI systems generate high-dimensional behavioural trajectories whose collective dynamics remain obscure. Using 297,915 learners' adaptive-tutoring histories, we define semantic order variables before model fitting and test them in user-disjoint cohorts. The state exhibits reproducible basin-like flow and operationally defined, state-heterogeneous metastable-like kinetics. A construction-matched null distinguishes normalised-memory relaxation from a reproducible excess field. A four-term conditional mechanism recovers population drift (r = 0.946; learner-bootstrap 95% CI, 0.935-0.955). Predictive event-level self-supervised learning recovers the state and learned-plane flow; null-referenced corrections retain directional, partial-amplitude excess-field structure without full calibration. Shuffled-order training reverses learned-plane flow on ordered trajectories; support-alignment randomisation selectively reduces inward

translated_title: 闭环人机学习系统中的可复现宏观动力学
translated_abstract: 闭环人机（人类-AI）系统会产生高维行为轨迹，其集体动力学机制仍不明确。基于297,915名学习者的自适应辅导历史，我们在模型拟合之前定义了语义序变量，并在用户不相交的队列中进行了检验。该状态展现出可复现的类盆地流动以及操作性定义的、状态异质的类亚稳动力学。通过构造匹配的零模型，我们区分了归一化记忆弛豫与可复现的过剩场。一个四项条件机制成功恢复了群体漂移（r = 0.946；学习者自举95%置信区间为0.935–0.955）。预测性事件级自监督学习恢复了状态空间和学习平面流动；以零模型为参照的校正在不完全校准的情况下仍保留了方向性和部分幅度的过剩场结构。打乱顺序的训练会使有序轨迹上的学习平面流动发生逆转；支持对齐随机化则选择性地减少了向内（流动）……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究基于近30万学习者的自适应辅导数据，在闭环人机学习系统中定义语义序变量，首次揭示了可复现的类盆地流动与亚稳态动力学，并通过四项条件机制（r=0.946）和事件级自监督学习成功恢复并验证了这些宏观动力学规律。
en_tdlr: Using adaptive-tutoring histories of nearly 300,000 learners, this study defines semantic order variables in a closed-loop human-AI learning system, revealing reproducible basin-like flow and metastable-like kinetics that are recovered and validated by a four-term conditional mechanism (r = 0.946) and predictive event-level self-supervised learning.
